brief.title: Caching: repeated work to reuse
brief.prompt: Explain caching through a change and an ordered request path
brief.intended_understanding: A cache reuses results and fetches missing data only when needed

story.thesis: Caching avoids repeated work while preserving a path for misses

beats.purpose: Contrast the same request before and after caching

beats.idea: A miss still fetches the needed data
beats.purpose: Show the ordered cache lookup path

scenes.purpose: Contrast the same request before and after caching
scenes.narration: Before caching, every request repeats the work. After caching, repeated requests reuse the result.
scenes.selection_rationale: The narration explicitly contrasts before and after behavior; a consistent pair makes the change visible.
scenes.composition: Two aligned panels share the same reading order and typography.
scenes.motion_plan: Reveal each side on its source cue and hold the completed contrast.
scenes.transition: Clean cut into the request path.
scenes.layout_strategy: Equal measured panel widths and readable wrapped text inside the safe area.

scenes.purpose: Explain a cache lookup and miss path
scenes.narration: First check the cache, then fetch missing data, and finally return the result.
scenes.selection_rationale: First, then and finally express order; a progressive directed path makes that relationship visible.
scenes.composition: Three aligned stages with concise labels.
scenes.motion_plan: Reveal lookup, miss handling and result in order; settle before the final hold.
scenes.layout_strategy: Measured diagram labels and nonintersecting stage allocations.

design.rationale: Readable packaged typography, restrained accent and coherent motion
design.motion: Reveal relationships progressively and emphasize the narrated subject
